name: novel-line-revision
description: Perform a bounded prose-level revision while preserving accepted story state.
procedure: Lock accepted events, knowledge, and scene outcomes before touching prose.
Revise for specificity, rhythm, clarity, repetition, and narrative distance in the assigned scope.
Compare versions and stop after the declared pass unless a deterministic failure remains.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
